title: Run an external program and wait for it to exit
summary: Starts an external program from an extension command with System.Diagnostics.Process, captures its stdout and stderr, and waits a bounded time, killing the process tree on timeout so Altium Designer is never blocked indefinitely.
phrasings: launch an exe from Altium Designer
call a command-line tool and capture its output
run a process with a timeout from an extension

commands.name: RunExternalProcess
commands.description: Run an external program and wait for it to exit
